body:
More facts:

- I've tried Runtime.addShutdownHook(Thread thehook) and it is executed in 1.5.x not in 1.4.2
- I've tried  @Observes StartupEvent ev and @Observes ShutdownEvent ev - in 1.5.x only shutdown event is observed (in 1.4.2 both)

Important fact (from my POW) is that message from Runtime.addShutdownHook is printed before ClassPathUtils (from the description) are executed. It seems that problem is probably not in classLoading as I suggested in description. App is stopped but not started again.

Problem is caused by following change: 
https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/commit/57ca8e8b195dad9fc38126b1261b9d3a034667c4

body:
Simple solution is to add `LockSupport.park();` (see https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/commit/57ca8e8b195dad9fc38126b1261b9d3a034667c4#diff-10e19a8856031bf0bc6780fd924c1091L58)
I don't see possible impact and don't want to revert original change/fix. May I ask you your opinion about this, @stuartwdouglas ?
